Model-generated explanation — professional review required.

[Property 1] is a 4‑bedroom, 3‑bathroom residence in Austin with a lot size of 2,480 sq ft and a current stored active price of $749,000. The property has spent 56 days on the market according to the record. [property-01]

A CMA performed using 7 selected comparables yields a median price of $727,321. The empirical comparable range spans $719,400 to $738,100, with conservative, moderate, and aggressive anchors set at $719,400, $727,321, and $738,100, respectively. These anchors represent scenario reference points, not predicted sale probabilities. [cma-01] [property-02] [property-03] [property-04] [property-05] [property-06] [property-07] [property-08]

The CMA calculation employed explicit assumptions: a $110 per square‑foot adjustment, $12,000 per bedroom, $15,000 per bathroom, and a 0.00 % monthly trend. Comparables were filtered to within 3 miles and 180 days of sale, and weights were assigned based on inverse distance, sale age, and relative size difference. [cma-01]

The adjustment methodology and distance/age/size filters are user‑specified and not learned from data; thus, they should be reviewed and potentially calibrated by a professional. Lot size, school boundaries, concessions, permits, title status, and unobserved condition are not modeled, so they could materially affect value. Additionally, bedroom and square‑footage adjustments may double‑count related value—sensitivity testing is advised. [cma-01]

All property and market evidence in this workspace is fictional demonstration data.
